purpose: Real uv wheel-only failure messages fed through the production collect()/advise() path of each build.
how: probes/capture_wheel_messages.py runs the trial's own install argv shape (uv pip install --no-config --only-binary=:all: -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt in a fresh uv venv) with runner.execute's child setup (environment copy + NO_COLOR, stdin DEVNULL, new session, piped output).

probes/test_wheel_messages.py feeds each captured output to collect() and advise() with the same monkeypatch as tests/test_dependency_resolution.py::test_wheel_restriction_names_actual_blocker_without_blaming_changed_package; only the uv output differs.
The requirement sets were chosen by hand to reach different uv message shapes; they are probes, not a sample, so no rate is implied.

width_check.finding: Output is wrapped at a fixed width near 80 columns without a terminal; COLUMNS=40 and COLUMNS=200 give the same text as no COLUMNS.
